_readme: Every destination the game knows, so a spoken name can be corrected to the exact string its search box expects. Whisper hears 'Laura Ville'; this turns it into 'Lorville' before it is pasted. Regenerate from the starmap data; 'live' means it is in the current game build. Entries marked src=uex were added from UEX's live terminal list, which knows reachable stations the RSI starmap does not name -- the inter-system Gateways above all came from there.
